reason: Guests book me because they trust Booking.com's name and its reviews, and a page with my own logo doesn't change that overnight. I'd grab the free commission calculator to see the number, but I'm not paying $800 for a brand and booking page when Booking.com still sends me most of my bed nights.
objection: Guests trust Booking.com more than my own website, and if I push them off it I could lose the visibility that fills the rooms.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a guesthouse like mine actually get direct bookings from the Instagram link, with the numbers, plugged into the SiteMinder or Cloudbeds system I already use so I don't have to rebuild anything.
